title: Big-O is polynomial for unambiguous weighted automata and decidable for finite ambiguity under Schanuel's conjecture

standard_prerequisites.name: Nonnegative weighted automata, labelled Markov chains, Perron-Frobenius matrix growth, probabilistic-automaton emptiness and exponential real arithmetic
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Complete original definitions and bbl retained. Existing Friedland-Schneider and Daviaud weight characterizations remain named prerequisites. Schanuel's conjecture is preserved as an explicit hypothesis in every original conditional result, including the selected conditional tasks.

core_obligations: Retain exact author principal theorem and complete proof including all constructions and reductions.
Preserve original Schanuel assumptions wherever stated; conditional decidability is never presented unconditionally.
Retain all author context, eight mathematical figures, macros, bibliography and source-local proof support.
difficulty_reason: H2: unambiguous ratios are treated using a product and multiplicative-cycle comparison, while finitely ambiguous reachable weights are represented through a finite algebraic characterization and encoded into the real exponential theory. These two ambiguity-frontier results form one grouped target; only the finite-ambiguity decidability claim relies on the original Schanuel assumption.
